desc: Analyze operation rules and reformulate the answer as min over orderings of (runs + inversions).
Derive the rightmost-first greedy stack algorithm and implement the O(N) solve_case.
Implement brute-force BFS solver and confirm the 3 public samples pass (3,4,8).
Run the definitive exhaustive BFS verification ({1,2} length <= 12, {1,2,3} length <= 9) with 0 mismatches.
Confirm the formula answer = R − (#δ=−2 merges) = (R + len(stack))//2 against samples and brute force.
Finalize fast-I/O Python solution (byte tokens, newline-separated answers for T up to 1e5).
